name: nexocord
description: Framework TypeScript moderno para criar bots escaláveis ​​do Discord com discord.js v14, apresentando arquitetura modular, cli e utilitários amigáveis ​​para desenvolvedores.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/core/types/index.ts src/core/ui/index.ts src/core/utils/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && bun build src/index.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist/index.cjs && bun build src/bin/cli.ts --outdir dist/bin --target node --format esm && mkdir -p dist/create && rm -rf dist/create/templates && cp -R src/create/templates dist/create/ && bunx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.publish:pkg: bun run build && npm publish --access public
